objective.value: Development of an engineered Escherichia coli strain capable of the complete biosynthesis of carminic acid (6) from glucose, by comparing type II and type III PKS machineries for the polyketide backbone, identifying enzymes for the remaining hydroxylation and C-glucosylation steps via biochemical reaction analyses, and enhancing the identified enzymes by in silico homology modeling and docking simulations.
objective.notes: Objective stated in Abstract and Introduction of the current article.

hypothesis.value: That a complete carminic acid biosynthetic pathway can be reconstituted in E. coli from glucose by combining an optimized type II PKS machinery with heterologous cyclases (ZhuI/ZhuJ) and with a monooxygenase and a C-glucosyltransferase identifiable through biochemical reaction analysis and improvable through structure-guided (homology modeling + docking) mutagenesis.
hypothesis.notes: The paper does not state an explicit formal hypothesis; this is a bounded inference from the stated objective and the strategy overview. Not a verbatim paper statement.

inference.rationale: Introduction (introduction_p010) states the study goal and the combined strategies (PKS comparison, biochemical reaction analysis, in silico mutagenesis); the Abstract (access_p003, access_p006) reports the same strategy chain leading to complete biosynthesis. The hypothesis is reconstructed as the implied testable proposition linking these stated elements; no additional external assumptions were added.

source_locations.quote: In this study, we report the development of an engineered Escherichia coli strain that is capable of the complete biosynthesis of 6 from glucose.
Here we report the complete biosynthesis of carminic acid from glucose in engineered Escherichia coli.

To biosynthesize the aromatic polyketide backbone of 6, the type II and III PKS machineries were compared. Also, biochemical reaction analyses were performed to identify the enzymes responsible for the later steps in the 6 biosynthetic pathway.
The E. coli BAP1 strain, which is a BL21(DE3) derivative integrated with Bacillus subtilis phosphopantetheinyl transferase (PPTase; encoded by sfp), was used as the host strain.
production of 6 from glucose was attempted by constructing the CA strain, which is the BAP1 strain harboring pFK and pCA.
the ALS strain, which is BL21(DE3) harboring pRSF-RpALS, pCDF-RpALS-GtCGTmut, pWAS-anti-pabA, and pBBR1-zwf.

the expression of antDEF (antD encoding KSalpha; antE encoding KSbeta; antF encoding ACP), antB (encoding a PPTase), and antG (encoding a CoA ligase) in E. coli BAP1 resulted in the highest 1 and 2 titers
one plasmid expression system was tested by cloning zhuIJ into pDS00-antDEFBG to make pFK
an engineered E. coli BL21(DE3) strain harboring pCDF-RpALS, pWAS-antipabA, and pBBR1-zwf, which expresses RpALS ..., anti-pabA synthetic sRNA, and zwf
increasing the malonyl-CoA pool was pursued by the overexpression of Corynebacterium glutamicum accBCD1 (encoding acetyl-CoA carboxylase complex) or knockdown of pabA
Structure-based in silico docking simulations of DnrF and GtCGT with 3 (as their common ligand) were performed to generate the mutant enzymes having enhanced activities.
Four diferent E. coli chaperones, DnaK-DnaJ-GrpE, GroES/EL, trigger factor (TF), and ClpB, were also employed to facilitate folding of insoluble heterologous enzymes.
fed-batch cultures were carried out to assess the performance of the strain in a 6.6 L bioreactor.
Five plasmids (pDnrF, pAct-VAVB, pTT7, pHpaBC, pPobA) each harboring the corresponding gene(s) were separately introduced into the FK strain (BAP1 harboring pFK) and were cultured in flasks.

The top 20 mutants ... were selected for experimental analysis. An additional 9 mutants ... generated by rational examination of the predicted DnrF structure were also selected. Each of these 29 mutants was introduced into the FK strain
C. glutamicum accBCD1 overexpression, pabA knockdown, and/or galU-pgm-ndk overexpression were tested alone or in combinations.
CT denotes the control FK strain.
The authenticity of 6 was confirmed by an LC-MS/MS analysis and a comparison of the MS/MS fragmentation pattern with that of the commercially available standard chemical
was constructed and cultured in bafled flasks.
The pH-stat fed-batch fermentation of the CA-ACC strain (for details, see Materials and Methods in the Supporting Information)
BAP1 harboring the type II PKS system resulted in a significantly higher production of 3 (15.1 mg/L) from glucose
ascorbic acid was supplemented to the medium, which increased the titer of 3 to 154.9 mg/L
The red arrow denotes the isopropyl beta-D-1-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG) induction time point.
In vivo conversion assays were performed by exogenously feeding luteolin, apigenin, and naringenin during the flask culture
Error bars denote mean ± standard deviation (SD; n = 3).
Data are means ± standard deviation (SD) of three independent experiments.
The authenticity of 1 and 2 was confirmed by LC-MS/MS (Figure S1a and Table S5) and NMR (Figures S20 and S21 and Table S6) analyses
Conversion of 3 into 4 and 4' by DnrF was confirmed by an in vitro enzyme assay (Figure S5).
the steady-state kinetic parameters of DnrF and DnrF P217K were determined (concentration of enzymes set to 1 uM)
fed-batch cultures were carried out to assess the performance of the strain in a 6.6 L bioreactor.

Yu Ri Lee at Chungnam National University Center for Research Facilities for LC-HRMS analyses, Dr. Yun-Cheol Na at Korea Basic Science Institute (KBSI), Western Seoul Center, for LC-MS/MS analyses, Ji Won Kim at KAIST Bio Core Center for LC-MS (MRM) analyses, and Jae Hyun Lee at KBSI, Western Seoul Center, for NMR analysis.

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Active selection and implementation of a specific type II minimal PKS construct (antDEFBG) as the pathway platform; passes Q1 (heterologous expression construct choice), Q2 (tested in this study), Q3 (design choice among alternatives).
ddr_annotations.design_action: Express antDEF, antB and antG (antDEFBG) from Photorhabdus luminescens in E. coli BAP1 (pDS00-antDEFBG) as the type II minimal PKS platform.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: AntDEF was reported (ref 31) to be soluble and functional in E. coli; among tested component combinations antDEFBG gave the highest 1 and 2 titers (P = 2.1e-3 and 8.2e-4).
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Prior literature: type II minimal PKSs are mostly insoluble in non-Streptomyces hosts; AntDEF from P. luminescens was reported soluble and functional in E. coli (ref 31). Trigger precedes the action.
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: screening_result (in-house comparison of component combinations; details in unavailable Supplementary Note S1) supported by literature_precedent (ref 31).
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: Construct chosen because it gave the highest measured shunt-product titers among the combinations tested in this study.
ddr_annotations.alternatives_considered: Other type II PKS component combinations (Supplementary Note S1, unavailable); type III PKSs AaOKS, AaPKS4, AaPKS5 (AaPKS5 retained for head-to-head comparison).

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Choice of type II over type III PKS machinery for flavokermesic acid (3) production after direct comparison; Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: Adopt the type II PKS system (AntDEFBG + ZhuIJ) rather than the type III PKS (AaPKS5 + ZhuIJ) for 3 production.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: Type II system produced 15.1 mg/L of 3 vs 4.3 mg/L for type III (P = 4.1e-4).
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Both machineries showed similar 1 and 2 production (P = 0.28 and 0.85), prompting the head-to-head 3 comparison.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: Selection based on measured titer difference in this study.
ddr_annotations.alternatives_considered: Type III PKS AaPKS5 (carried through the comparison, then not pursued for 3).

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Plasmid architecture redesign from two plasmids to a single plasmid (pFK); Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: Clone zhuIJ into pDS00-antDEFBG to generate the single-plasmid system pFK.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: Stated a priori: to reduce the metabolic burden of having two plasmids. Post-hoc, authors suggest colocalization may have increased transient complex formation ('is thought to have').
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Recognition that the two-plasmid system imposes metabolic burden (stated before the action).
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: experimental_measurement (88.0 mg/L vs 15.1 mg/L of 3, P = 1.8e-5); the mechanistic explanation (colocalization) is author interpretation, not separately tested.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: The burden-reduction rationale was stated before the experiment; the colocalization mechanism is a post-hoc interpretation and is not treated as validated.

generalizable_rule.rule: In E. coli BAP1 producing flavokermesic acid (3), consolidating minimal PKS (antDEFBG) and cyclase (zhuIJ) genes onto one plasmid (pFK) increased the 3 titer from 15.1 to 88.0 mg/L relative to the two-plasmid arrangement.
generalizable_rule.tested_scope: E. coli BAP1, flask culture, antDEFBG + zhuIJ, 3 production
generalizable_rule.excluded_scope: other hosts, other gene sets/products, and the causal contribution of colocalization vs burden reduction (not separately tested)

ddr_annotations.alternatives_considered: Two-plasmid system (pDS00-antDEFBG + pCDF-zhuIJ), retained as comparator.

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Medium supplementation decision in response to an observed phenotype; Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: Supplement ascorbic acid to the medium during 3 production.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: To prevent excess oxidation causing polymerization of 3 into melanin-like compounds (as reported for similar aromatic polyketides, ref 39).
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Culture gradually turned from bright red to brownish (Figure S1d), interpreted as possible polymerization of 3. Observation precedes the action.
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: experimental_measurement (titer increased to 154.9 mg/L, P = 4.2e-3); mechanistic basis is literature_analogy (ref 39) plus author interpretation of the color change. Ascorbate concentration not reported in available text.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: Action explicitly motivated by an oxidation/polymerization mechanism inferred from the observed color change and prior reports on similar polyketides; the mechanism itself was not independently verified in this paper.

generalizable_rule.rule: Ascorbic acid supplementation increased the flavokermesic acid (3) titer of E. coli BAP1(pFK) flask cultures from 88.0 to 154.9 mg/L, plausibly by limiting oxidative polymerization of 3.
generalizable_rule.tested_scope: E. coli BAP1(pFK), flask culture, 3 production; dose not reported in available text
generalizable_rule.excluded_scope: other products, hosts, doses; mechanistic confirmation of polymerization inhibition not performed

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Cofactor/precursor supply engineering to increase malonyl-CoA; Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: Overexpress Corynebacterium glutamicum accBCD1 (acetyl-CoA carboxylase complex); pabA knockdown tested in parallel.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: To increase the malonyl-CoA pool for enhanced 3 production, as recently reported by the same group (ref 5).
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Goal to further enhance 3 production after pFK + ascorbate; prior group report (ref 5) that accBCD1 OE / pabA KD increase malonyl-CoA availability.
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: stoichiometric_constraint (malonyl-CoA as precursor) plus literature_precedent (ref 5); measured result 180.3 mg/L but P = 0.105 (NS after Bonferroni), so the titer effect at this step is statistically weak.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: Strategy explicitly adopted from the group's previous report (ref 5) with a stoichiometric precursor-supply rationale.

generalizable_rule.rule: accBCD1 overexpression to raise the malonyl-CoA pool was associated with increased polyketide titers in E. coli BAP1 (3: 154.9 -> 180.3 mg/L, NS at this step) and in the CA strain background (6: 22.2 -> 74.9 ug/L, P = 2.3e-3).
generalizable_rule.tested_scope: E. coli BAP1-derived strains producing 3 or 6, flask culture
generalizable_rule.excluded_scope: statistical significance not achieved for the 3-enhancement step; other hosts/products untested

ddr_annotations.alternatives_considered: pabA knockdown (tested as alternative malonyl-CoA strategy).

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Enzyme discovery by candidate screening (biochemical reaction analysis); Q1-Q3 pass (selection and introduction of candidate enzymes is an engineering action).
ddr_annotations.design_action: Screen five monooxygenase candidates (DnrF, ActVA-ORF5/ActVB, TT7/ATR2, HpaBC, PobA) in the FK strain; select DnrF for 3 -> 4 hydroxylation.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: Candidates selected from different enzyme categories based on literature and chemical databases for reactions similar to the desired hydroxylation; DnrF gave the highest 4 titer (P = 6.6e-7).
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Only trace 4 was produced (possibly by inherent E. coli oxygenases) and the responsible monooxygenase had not been reported; conversion efficiency too low for 6 production.
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: screening_result (Figure 2a, n = 3) with in vitro confirmation (Figure S5, unavailable).
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: DnrF selected because it showed the highest measured activity among candidates tested in this study.
ddr_annotations.alternatives_considered: ActVA-ORF5/ActVB, TT7/ATR2, HpaBC, PobA (all tested, lower or no 4 production).

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Abandonment of DcUGT2 after failed engineering and subsequent CGT candidate screening; Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: After failed DcUGT2 truncation/OmpA-fusion attempts, screen eight CGT candidates (IroB, ZmCGT, FeCGT, MiCGT, OsCGT, GmCGT, GtCGT, AvCGT); select GtCGT for 3 -> 5 C-glucosylation.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: DcUGT2 (native, Ntr, Ctr, Ntr-Ctr, and OmpA-fused variants) produced no 5 in E. coli; among the 8 candidates only GtCGT converted 3 to 5.
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: No production of 5 by any DcUGT2 construct in the FK strain (negative result precedes the screening decision).
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: screening_result (Figure 2c,d, n = 3) with LC-MS/MS, NMR and in vitro assay confirmation.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: GtCGT selected as the only candidate showing the desired activity in this study's screen.
ddr_annotations.alternatives_considered: DcUGT2 and its engineered variants (abandoned after failure); seven other CGT candidates (no 5 produced).

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: UDP-glucose supply engineering to support C-glucosylation; Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: Overexpress galU, pgm and ndk in the FK + GtCGT background.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: C-glucosylation requires a high UDP-glucose pool; overexpression intended to enhance UDP-glucose generation and UDP recycling (ref 60).
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Pathway requirement: GtCGT uses UDP-glucose as cosubstrate (stated as rationale before the action).
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: experimental_measurement (2.3-fold increase of 5, Figure 2c) motivated by stoichiometric_constraint and literature_precedent (ref 60).
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: Cosubstrate supply rationale stated a priori and supported by literature; effect measured in this study.

generalizable_rule.rule: galU-pgm-ndk overexpression increased GtCGT-dependent production of 5 by 2.3-fold in the E. coli FK strain background.
generalizable_rule.tested_scope: E. coli FK strain expressing GtCGT, flask culture, 5 production
generalizable_rule.excluded_scope: other CGTs/hosts/products untested; effect size specific to this background

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Structure-guided enzyme engineering of DnrF; Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: Generate and screen 29 DnrF mutants predicted by homology modeling (MODELLER, template RdmE PDB 3IHG) and PyRosetta docking plus rational inspection; adopt DnrF P217K.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: Predicted enhanced binding affinity toward 3; P217K gave the highest 4 production (2.2-fold over wild type); double mutant P217K/M56A decreased 4 and was rejected.
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Wild-type DnrF activity was insufficient: the initial pathway assembly (EXP07) produced no detectable 6, speculated to be due to insufficient downstream enzyme activities. Trigger precedes mutagenesis.
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: computational_prediction (docking scores; requires experimental confirmation) combined with experimental_measurement (mutant screen n = 2; kinetics: KM -23.7%, Vmax/KM +33.4%, three independent experiments). The authors note expression was unaffected and attribute improvement to an unknown reason such as higher specific activity.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: Mutants were computationally predicted but the final selection (P217K) was based on measured 4 titers; the mechanistic explanation remains speculative per the authors.
ddr_annotations.alternatives_considered: DnrF M56A (second best); DnrF P217K/M56A double mutant (rejected: decreased 4 titer).

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Structure-guided enzyme engineering of GtCGT including a rationally designed double mutant; Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: Generate and screen 34 GtCGT mutants; construct and adopt the double mutant GtCGT V93Q/Y193F.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: V93Q (best single, 2.8-fold) combined with Y193F; Y193F predicted to allow a robust hydrogen bond between Gln93 and the C6 hydroxyl of 3, orienting it for C2 C-glucosylation; double mutant gave 5.3-fold higher 5 titer and +46.8% Vmax/KM.
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Wild-type GtCGT activity insufficient for 6 production (EXP07 negative result); docking predictions indicated beneficial mutations. Trigger precedes action.
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: computational_prediction (PyRosetta/AutoDock Vina binding energies; requires experimental confirmation) plus experimental_measurement (5 titer, n = 2; kinetics, three independent experiments). Structural mechanism remains a prediction.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: The double mutant was designed from an explicit structure-based mechanistic hypothesis (hydrogen-bond network orienting the ligand) stated before its construction; kinetics support improved efficiency but the structural mechanism itself was not experimentally verified.

generalizable_rule.rule: GtCGT V93Q/Y193F shows enhanced C-glucosylation of aromatic polyketides in E. coli: 5.3-fold higher 5 titer from 3 and detectable conversion of aloesone (7) to aloesin (8).
generalizable_rule.tested_scope: E. coli BAP1(FK) and BL21(DE3) backgrounds; substrates 3 and 7; flask culture
generalizable_rule.excluded_scope: flavonoid substrates (luteolin, apigenin, naringenin) showed decreased conversion; other hosts/substrates untested; structural mechanism predicted, not verified

ddr_annotations.alternatives_considered: GtCGT V93Q and Y193F single mutants (lower activity than the double mutant).

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Application of the engineered CGT to a second product (aloesin); Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: Use GtCGT V93Q/Y193F to convert aloesone (7) to aloesin (8) in engineered BL21(DE3); increase RpALS copy number (ALS strain).
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: GtCGT V93Q/Y193F had the highest activity toward 3; the CGT for 7 -> 8 had not been identified; authors sought to test generality on similar C-glucosylation reactions.
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Prior result: GtCGT V93Q/Y193F was the best CGT for 3 -> 5 in this study; literature gap: no CGT known for 7 -> 8.
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: experimental_measurement (8 produced at 0.060 ug/L with GtCGTmut, 0.30 ug/L in ALS strain; authenticity by LC-MS/MS vs standard). Titers are very low and flagged for unit verification.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: The mutant was chosen because it had the highest measured activity in the prior screen; the generality hypothesis is an intra-paper substrate-similarity analogy rather than a reported mechanism.

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Selection of the final production strain after combinatorial metabolic engineering; Q1-Q3 pass.
ddr_annotations.design_action: Select CA-ACC (CA + accBCD1 overexpression) as the final carminic acid production strain.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: CA-ACC gave the highest 6 titer (74.9 ug/L, 3.4-fold over CA, P = 2.3e-3); combining accBCD1 OE with dnaKJ-grpE OE did not further increase the titer (44.4 ug/L).
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Measured titers across the tested strategies (accBCD1 OE, pabA KD, galU-pgm-ndk OE, chaperone coexpression) precede the selection.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: Final strain chosen on measured titers; the expectation that accBCD1 + dnaKJ-grpE would further increase 6 was tested and falsified before selection.
ddr_annotations.alternatives_considered: pabA KD; galU-pgm-ndk OE; chaperones dnaKJ-grpE, groES/EL, TF, ClpB; accBCD1 + dnaKJ-grpE combination (all tested, lower or non-additive).

ddr_annotations.decision_type_rationale: Fed-batch fermentation of CA-ACC is a scale-up performance assessment of the already-selected final strain; Q1 (process operation) and Q2 pass, but Q3 (a new design choice) does not - it is classified as validation, not an engineering decision.
ddr_annotations.design_action: pH-stat fed-batch fermentation of CA-ACC in a 6.6 L bioreactor with IPTG induction; two independent runs.
ddr_annotations.design_action_rationale: Stated purpose: to assess the performance of the strain at bioreactor scale.
ddr_annotations.trigger_observation: Selection of CA-ACC as the final strain (precedes fermentation).
ddr_annotations.evidence_grading_rationale: evidence_basis_type: experimental_measurement (0.65 and 0.61 mg/L of 6; 3.66 g/L max of 3). Fermentation parameters are in the unavailable SI.
ddr_annotations.reason_nature_rationale: No design rationale beyond performance assessment is reported; mapped to rationale_not_reported because no optimization decision motivated the run.
